material.acceptance_criteria: CI runs N ticks of the moba pack natively and in the built wasm (node with the pkg) and fails when the final state_hash differs.
material.description: Players run wasm, replays and tests run native (rust/crates/sim, rust/crates/web). sim has no f32/f64 beyond fixed.rs:24 to_float, but the Lua VM (f64 math.floor division in targeting.lua:117,132) and piccolo ahash run on both. grep for state_hash in rust/crates tests finds no cross-target pair.

notes.note: drain-infra-9: not taken; needs a node harness over the wasm Game API matching rust/gate state_hash scenario (gate prints state_hash= units= ticks=); unknown web API load path for mods.
